channel.title: Boolean Bros — Notes
channel.description: A shipping log from an independent mobile studio.

item.title: Five builds to find a line of spaces
item.description: Byte-Sized Tycoon 1.4 spent a full day failing to open. The build quit in under a second, before the splash screen, with a SIGABRT and no JavaScript error in either the system log or the crash report. Five builds went out chasing it: one reverting a layout change, one adding a full-screen error handler, one fixing a genuinely bare string in a tab label, and one teaching that handler to print the component stack.

item.title: A photo compressor that cannot see your photos
item.description: Image Shrinker now runs in the browser as well as on Android. Pick a target size — 20 KB for a form, 200 KB for email — and the compressor hits it without uploading anything, because there is no server to upload to.

item.title: Byte-Sized Tycoon 1.1: fewer ads, by policy
item.description: App Review rejected 1.1 for showing "multiple consecutive ads". The cause was structural: four different reset actions each fired an interstitial with no coordination, so two resets in quick succession produced two full-screen ads.

item.title: Surviving the iOS 27 launch requirement
item.description: A build compiled with the iOS 27 SDK crashes on launch without a scene manifest — EXC_BREAKPOINT inside UIKitCore, before any of our code runs. The fix is UIScene adoption: a scene delegate that owns the window and boots React Native.

item.title: Image Shrinker is live on Google Play
item.description: A photo compressor that runs entirely on the phone: exact target sizes, batch jobs you can stop and resume, and metadata stripped before anything is saved or shared.

item.title: Byte-Sized Tycoon 1.0 ships on both stores
item.description: One miner, seven tiers of hardware, and an Orbital Data Center at the top. Prestige resets the run for permanent multipliers, and the machines keep earning while the app is closed.
